_comment: Wall paints (Paint tab). LIVE fields: swatch = flat PNG used as this item's coin-shop preview (shop-sold ids only). tex is informational: texture ids bind in assets.lua (A.WALLPAINT), and the default_* entries are wired to the DEFAULT_FLOOR/DEFAULT_PAINT constants in room.lua.
